prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production web UI scenic background for the Mind Garden “Heart Basket” workspace
Primary request: Create an exquisite warm contemporary New Chinese 3D “paper weaving desk” that makes private concerns feel gently held, with no interface chrome and no text.
Scene/backdrop: a shallow architectural niche in warm rice-paper plaster and pale ash wood, seen slightly from above; a low woven bamboo-and-wood receiving tray flows into an open wall lattice.
Subject: several completely blank xuan-paper slips of varied but restrained sizes, softly threaded through the lattice or resting in the tray, held by tiny aged-brass pins and muted plum cords; one empty porcelain catch dish; the physical arrangement suggests concerns can be placed, revisited, edited, or released.
Style/medium: premium product-design 3D render, contemporary New Chinese craft, tactile materials, fresh and warm rather than antique, elegant editorial restraint.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2; keep the left 38 percent calm and lightly textured for a semantic writing form; concentrate the woven tray and blank-paper record rhythm across the center and right; clear depth layers and generous breathing room.
Lighting/mood: soft late-morning window light, grounded offset shadows, intimate and reassuring, no melancholy darkness.
Color palette: warm ivory, rice paper, pale ash, biscuit limestone, muted plum cord, restrained aged brass, a very small indigo ceramic detail; no dominant green.
Materials/textures: visible xuan fibers, fine woven bamboo, matte porcelain, wood grain, honest brass; nothing glossy.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no icons, no buttons, no UI cards, no people, no handwriting, no personal data; blank slips must remain plain enough for HTML record overlays.
Avoid: literal basket icon, wicker picnic basket, spa décor, Japanese zen cliché, green plants as focal subject, clutter, ornate traditional furniture, cartoon, floating objects, fake interface screenshot.
